cues.title: 细菌围着光，还是围着氧？
cues.caption: 光改变产氧位置，细菌指示氧的分布。
cues.captionEn: Bacteria reveal where oxygen is produced.
cues.zh: 细菌聚在光斑旁，是因为它们喜欢光吗？在教材重构中，先给水绵一小束光，再看同一批需氧细菌怎样重新分布。它们指示的是氧。光照让附近叶绿体产氧，细菌在这些区域更集中。再改成全面照光，聚集区域也随之扩展。这个对照支持氧与受光叶绿体有关；细菌不是直接测光的仪器。
cues.en: Do these bacteria gather because they like light? In this textbook reconstruction, illuminate a small part of the alga and follow the same bacteria. They indicate oxygen. Illuminated chloroplasts release it, and bacteria become more concentrated nearby. Now illuminate the whole filament. The occupied region broadens. This links oxygen release to illuminated chloroplasts; the bacteria are not direct light meters.

cues.title: 哪一段光更能支持产氧？
cues.caption: 蓝紫光和红光区域，产氧指示更明显。
cues.captionEn: Oxygen gathers near blue and red light.
cues.zh: 把白光分成不同颜色，同时落在同一条水绵上。现在观察的是细菌分布，不是叶片看起来有多亮。蓝紫光和红光区域聚集较多，说明这些波段更能支持这个体系产氧。这是光合作用作用效果的证据；它不是直接测得的色素吸收曲线，更不能由细菌个数算出精确光合速率。
cues.en: Spread white light into colors across one filament. Watch the distribution of bacteria, not how bright the alga looks. More gather in blue and red regions, indicating stronger support for oxygen production in this system. This is evidence about photosynthetic action. It is not a direct pigment absorption spectrum, and bacterial counts here are not precise reaction rates.

cues.title: 没有二氧化碳，也能放氧吗？
cues.titleEn: Can oxygen appear without carbon dioxide?
cues.caption: 离体体系中，放氧可与固定 CO₂ 分开。
cues.captionEn: Oxygen release can occur without CO₂.
cues.zh: 两份离体叶绿体悬液都没有二氧化碳，也都有适宜的电子受体。一个照光，一个保持黑暗。照光组仍能检出氧气。这排除了什么？释放氧气不必等待二氧化碳先被固定。水被氧化时失去的电子还需要去处；拿掉适宜受体，持续放氧就受限制。这是离体体系的条件对照，并不说明完整植物不需要二氧化碳。
cues.en: Neither isolated chloroplast sample has carbon dioxide. Both have a suitable electron acceptor, but only one receives light. Oxygen is detected in the illuminated sample. What does that exclude? Oxygen release need not wait for carbon fixation. Electrons removed as water is oxidized still need an acceptor; removing it restricts sustained oxygen release. This isolated-system comparison does not make carbon dioxide unnecessary for a whole plant.

cues.title: 给两种氧换上不同标签
cues.titleEn: Label the two possible oxygen sources
cues.caption: 标记水，标记才出现在释放的氧气中。
cues.zh: 释放的氧来自水，还是二氧化碳？两组分别标记这两种原料中的氧。跟住水的两个氧：在这幅教材示意里，它们保持身份，进入释放的氧气。把标记放在二氧化碳上，氧气就不跟着变。这个对照辨别氧的来源；画面只追踪氧，不是完整反应机理。
cues.en: Does released oxygen come from water or carbon dioxide? Label the two inputs in separate samples. Follow water’s two oxygens into released oxygen. Labeling carbon dioxide instead does not label that product. This comparison distinguishes the source. We are tracing oxygen identities, not every atom or intermediate reaction.

cues.title: 光怎样推动 ATP 合成？
cues.titleEn: How does light support ATP synthesis?
cues.caption: 梯度驱动合成；从旁路泄漏不能代替耦联。
cues.captionEn: A coupled gradient drives ATP synthesis.
cues.zh: 阿尔农的离体叶绿体研究发现，光下可以形成ATP。光怎样推动合成？后来独立的酸碱实验中，两组进入同样的碱性环境，在黑暗里仍得到不同的ATP总量。切到现代模型：光提高电子能量，耦联传递让质子在类囊体腔积累，形成电化学差。跟住一个质子，经入口结合转子，随转子移动，再从另一个出口离开。转轴连接基质侧催化头，耦联ADP和磷酸合成ATP，质子并没有变成磷酸。同样的初始梯度若另开泄漏，更多能量散失，合成减少。
cues.en: Arnon’s isolated chloroplasts formed A. T. P. in light. How? A later acid–base experiment found different A. T. P. totals in darkness, after both samples entered the same alkaline stage. In the modern model, light raises electron energy; coupled transfer accumulates protons inside thylakoids, building an electrochemical gradient. Follow one proton into its rotor binding site, around the rotor, and through a separate exit. The shaft couples rotation to the stromal head, where A. D. P. and phosphate form A. T. P. The proton does not become phosphate. Repeat with the same starting gradient and a leak. More energy dissipates, leaving less for synthesis.

cues.title: 熄灯后，为什么还没有立刻停？
cues.titleEn: Why not stop immediately when light goes off?
cues.caption: 光反应补给载体，碳反应消耗有限存量。
cues.captionEn: Carrier stores keep reactions going briefly.
cues.zh: ATP给碳反应供能，另一种还原型载体提供还原力。用过后，ADP、磷酸和氧化型载体返回，再被补给。现在熄灯：已有存量不会立即消失，碳反应先继续，再随着存量耗尽而受限。可见“暗反应”并不是只在黑暗中进行。
cues.en: A. T. P. supplies energy for carbon reactions; N. A. D. P. H. supplies reducing power. Used carriers return for replenishment. Switch off the light. Stored carriers support reactions briefly, then run low. The so-called dark reactions are therefore not restricted to darkness.

cues.title: 碳的第一站，怎样被找到？
cues.titleEn: How was carbon’s early destination identified?
cues.caption: 独立取样与化学鉴定，约束碳的去向。
cues.captionEn: Trace carbon, then identify the products.
cues.zh: 给小球藻提供标记二氧化碳，在不同时刻分别终止反应、分离产物。这是五秒和三十秒独立样本的部分特征；斑点大小不表示含量。标准品和化学分析才能鉴定斑点。更早取样与碳位置证据支持三碳的磷酸甘油酸是早期稳定产物。看净碳骨架：五个原有碳接入一个新碳，形成两组三碳；新碳进入其中一组的羧基。完整循环还需要更多证据。若更早终止，应该优先寻找什么产物？
cues.en: Supply labeled carbon dioxide, stop separate algal samples, and separate their products. These are selected features from five- and thirty-second samples; spot sizes are not measured amounts. Standards and chemical analysis identify the spots. Earlier sampling and carbon-position evidence support phosphoglycerate as an early stable product. Now the net carbon map: five carbons receive one new carbon, producing two three-carbon groups. The new carbon enters a carboxyl. The full cycle required further evidence. With an earlier stop, which products should appear first?

cues.title: 先排除叶片原有的空气
cues.titleEn: First exclude air already inside the leaf
cues.caption: 减压排气，复压进水，建立共同下沉起点。
cues.captionEn: Replace trapped air with water first.
cues.zh: 叶片浮起来，一定是刚刚产生了氧气吗？先看叶片原有的含气间隙。拉动活塞降低压力，气体膨胀并排出；恢复压力后，水进入这些间隙，圆片才会下沉。这个处理的目的，是让各组有可比较的起点。若叶片本来就带着空气漂浮，就不能把上浮全部归因于这段时间的光合作用。
cues.en: Does a floating leaf disc necessarily contain newly produced oxygen? Look at the air already in its spaces. Lower pressure lets gas expand and escape. Restoring pressure lets water replace it, so discs sink. This establishes comparable starting conditions. If trapped air makes a disc float before illumination, that flotation cannot all be attributed to newly occurring photosynthesis.

cues.title: 光强怎样变成上浮差异？
cues.titleEn: How does light intensity change flotation?
cues.caption: 上浮取决于净积气，不等于总产氧或 ATP。
cues.captionEn: Net gas gain makes the discs rise.
cues.zh: 各组十片都先下沉，只改变光强。产氧减去呼吸等消耗，剩余气体积累，使圆片平均密度下降，越过上浮阈值。强光组因此较早上浮。预测一下：缺少二氧化碳，或者原有空气没有排出，结果还支持相同推断吗？上浮只是有条件的间接指标，不能换算总产氧或ATP数量。
cues.en: Each group starts with ten sunken discs; only light differs. Oxygen production minus consumption leaves net gas, lowering average density until discs float. Stronger light gives earlier flotation in this model. Predict the result without carbon dioxide, or without removing trapped air. This indirect indicator cannot be converted into total oxygen or A. T. P. counts.

question.zh: 细菌为什么聚在受光叶绿体附近？
question.en: Why do bacteria gather near illuminated chloroplasts?

lead.zh: 比较局部和全面照光，跟住同一批需氧细菌。
lead.en: Compare local and full illumination, following the same bacteria.

principle.zh: 光改变产氧位置；需氧细菌是氧分布的间接指示者。
principle.en: Light changes oxygen production; aerobic bacteria indirectly indicate oxygen distribution.

question.zh: 把光改成全面照射，聚集区域会怎样改变？

explanation.zh: 在其他条件适宜时，产氧区域扩展，细菌聚集不再局限于原光斑。
explanation.en: Under suitable conditions the oxygen-producing region expands, so aggregation is no longer limited to the original spot.

question.zh: 哪些颜色更能支持产氧？
question.en: Which colors better support oxygen production?

lead.zh: 把同一束白光分散到同一材料，观察氧的间接指示。
lead.en: Disperse light across one specimen and observe an indirect oxygen indicator.

principle.zh: 细菌空间分布约束不同波段的光合作用效果，不直接给出吸收曲线。
principle.en: Bacterial distribution constrains photosynthetic action across wavelengths, not the absorption spectrum itself.

question.zh: 细菌少的绿色区，能否直接证明绿色光完全无效？
question.en: Do fewer bacteria in green light prove that green light is entirely ineffective?

explanation.zh: 不能。它是该条件下的相对作用证据，模型中绿色作用也没有设为零。
explanation.en: No. This is relative evidence under particular conditions; the model does not set green-light action to zero.

question.zh: 没有 CO₂ 的离体叶绿体，为什么还能检出氧？
question.en: Why can isolated chloroplasts release oxygen without CO₂?

lead.zh: 先看无 CO₂ 的光暗对照，再检查电子受体条件。
lead.en: Start with the light–dark comparison without CO₂, then examine the acceptor requirement.

principle.zh: 放氧来自水的氧化；持续电子传递需要适宜受体，可与固定碳分开研究。
principle.en: Oxygen release derives from water oxidation; sustained transfer requires an acceptor and can be studied separately from carbon fixation.

question.zh: 移除电子受体，仍应持续放氧吗？
question.en: Should sustained oxygen release continue without the acceptor?

explanation.zh: 在这个离体模型中不应；该结论限定于适宜受体缺失的体系。
explanation.en: Not in this isolated model; the conclusion is conditional on losing a suitable acceptor.

question.zh: 释放的氧气来自水还是 CO₂？
question.en: Does released oxygen come from water or CO₂?

lead.zh: 两组分别标记，保持氧原子身份再看产物。
lead.en: Label the inputs separately and preserve oxygen identities into the product.

principle.zh: 释放氧的标记跟随水，从两种来源假说中作出区分。
principle.en: The released oxygen label follows water, distinguishing the two source hypotheses.

question.zh: 把标记改放在 CO₂ 的氧上，释放氧的标签会怎样？
question.en: What if the oxygen label is placed in CO₂ instead?

explanation.zh: 在教材的理想化来源实验中，释放氧不因此带上该标记；不将此示意推广成全部氧交换细节。
explanation.en: In the idealized textbook provenance experiment, that label does not appear in released oxygen; this omits the detailed oxygen-exchange network.

question.zh: 光怎样支持 ADP 和 Pi 合成 ATP？
question.en: How does light support ATP synthesis from ADP and Pi?

lead.zh: 把早期光合磷酸化结果、后来的黑暗酸碱实验和现代解释分开比较。
lead.en: Separate early photophosphorylation results, a later dark acid–base experiment, and the modern explanation.

principle.zh: 光建立的质子电化学差可通过旋转催化耦联合成；光并非直接把磷酸粘上 ADP。
principle.en: A proton electrochemical difference can drive rotary coupling to synthesis; light does not simply attach phosphate to ADP.

question.zh: 同样初始梯度增加泄漏，ATP 会更多吗？
question.en: Would more leakage from the same initial gradient make more ATP?

explanation.zh: 模型中泄漏耗散可用能量，降低通过合成酶耦联的产量；不能拿该教学速率拟合历史测值。
explanation.en: The model dissipates more available energy through the leak and supports less coupled synthesis; its teaching kinetics do not fit the historical assay.

question.zh: 熄灯后，碳反应为什么可以短暂继续？
question.en: Why can carbon reactions continue briefly after darkness?

lead.zh: 观察膜与基质之间往返的载体和有限存量。
lead.en: Follow carriers between membrane and stroma and the finite stores.

principle.zh: 光反应补给 ATP、NADPH；碳反应使用它们并返回待补给的载体。
principle.en: Light reactions replenish ATP and NADPH; carbon reactions use them and return carriers for replenishment.

question.zh: 完全没有先前光照形成的存量，熄灯后还能持续合成吗？
question.en: Without stores accumulated beforehand, can synthesis continue in darkness?

explanation.zh: 该模型不能；暗中短暂继续依赖存量，真实调节还会影响持续时间。
explanation.en: Not in this model: brief continuation requires stored resources, and real regulation also affects its duration.

question.zh: 碳进入哪一种早期产物，怎样从实验判断？
question.en: How can experiments identify an early product of carbon fixation?

lead.zh: 先读独立终止样本，再用化学鉴定约束现代碳骨架模型。
lead.en: Read independently quenched samples before using chemical identification to constrain a modern carbon map.

principle.zh: 早期取样与碳位置分析支持 3-PGA 的早期稳定产物身份；完整循环需要更多证据。
principle.en: Early sampling and positional analysis support 3-PGA as an early stable product; the complete cycle requires additional evidence.

question.zh: 把取样提前，能只凭一张斑点图确定完整循环吗？
question.en: Could an earlier chromatogram alone determine the complete cycle?

explanation.zh: 不能；可检验标记更早出现的位置，但仍需化学身份、位置分析和其他条件实验。
explanation.en: No. It can test earlier label appearance, but chemical identity, positional analysis and other experiments remain necessary.

question.zh: 相同叶片为何在不同光强下先后上浮？
question.en: Why do matched leaf discs rise at different times?

lead.zh: 先排除原有气体，再比较净气体积累与上浮。
lead.en: First exclude trapped air, then compare net gas accumulation and flotation.

principle.zh: 叶片净积气降低平均密度；呼吸、CO₂ 和起始去气都影响指标。
principle.en: Net gas accumulation reduces average density; respiration, CO₂ and initial infiltration all affect the indicator.

question.zh: 没有去除原有空气的圆片提前上浮，能说光合更强吗？
question.en: Does an uninfiltrated disc floating early prove stronger photosynthesis?

explanation.zh: 不能。原有气体破坏共同起点，上浮不能直接归因于新产氧，更不能换算为 ATP 数。
explanation.en: No. Trapped air breaks the common starting condition; early flotation cannot be attributed directly to new oxygen or converted into ATP counts.

sources.title: Hill (1937), Oxygen evolved by isolated chloroplasts
Ruben et al. (1941), Heavy Oxygen (O18) as a Tracer in the Study of Photosynthesis
Arnon, Allen & Whatley (1954), Photosynthesis by Isolated Chloroplasts
Jagendorf & Uribe (1966), ATP formation caused by acid-base transition of spinach chloroplasts
Hahn et al. (2018), Structure, mechanism, and regulation of the chloroplast ATP synthase
Calvin (1961), The Path of Carbon in Photosynthesis, original UCRL-9966 report
Dynamic photosynthetic labeling and carbon-positional mass spectrometry (2025)
SAPS, Investigating photosynthesis with leaf discs

topicSuggestion.title: 光合作用：氧从哪来，光怎样驱动合成？
topicSuggestion.titleEn: Photosynthesis: tracing oxygen and the work of light
topicSuggestion.description: 从独立对照、同位素和固定记录，追踪氧、质子梯度与碳的去向。
topicSuggestion.descriptionEn: Use controls, tracers and published records to follow oxygen, proton gradients and carbon.

modelBoundaries: Historical records are immutable and distinct from pedagogical kinetics.
1966 total luciferase ATP values141/12nmol per mg chlorophyll are not Arnon1954 data and not net-subtracted.
The light-to-gradient bridge is a selected coupled-transport episode, not an electron/H+ stoichiometry or the full quinone cycle.
The gradient model uses q=Cμ and a chosen45kJ/mol ATP synthesis cost; it is not an experimental fit. H+ never becomes phosphate.
c14 rotor structure and3 catalytic sites underpin coupling, but displayed cutaway is schematic. Redox regulation, buffer chemistry and atom-level ATP reaction omitted.
Calvin5s/30s are independent samples with selected qualitative features; no quantitative percentages, no same-sample time lapse.
Carbon-only net map uses independently supported positions; full hydration/proton-transfer mechanism not drawn.
Bacterial density, Hill bubbles, leaf-disc thresholds and carrier reservoirs are explanatory reconstructions, not historical measured counts.
Cyclic electron transfer can support ATP without O2 evolution, so ATP production is not equated to a fixed oxygen yield.
The leaf-disc CO₂ input omits dissolved and respiratory CO₂ stores; zero modeled supply does not imply instantaneous cessation of oxygen release in a real leaf after external CO₂ removal.
